updates.problem: Scoped authority is currently explicit but not yet represented as a formal partial order across grounding, representation, mechanism, identification and decision dimensions.
updates.target: Freeze known-answer worlds and implement the smallest authority-certificate object that preserves incomparability and axis-specific no-escalation without forcing a total score or invalid joins.
required_known_answer_worlds: predictive black box has decision/prediction authority but not mechanism authority
mechanistic derivation with observational non-identifiability has mechanism authority but only set identification
all surviving mechanisms imply the same decision, so decision authority closes without mechanism identification
content/hash identity strengthens provenance but not scientific truth or mechanism
observational or QoI equivalence cannot mint mechanism equivalence
refutation withdraws active authority while preserving the prior certificate event

new_evidence: arXiv:2608.04066 explicitly separates LLM typed proposals from deterministic executive-owned belief/commitment
arXiv:2607.12650 makes a formal kernel the sole minter of Verified claims
GAVEL binds atomic claims to exact evidence units with deterministic scrutiny
updates.consequence: T002 proposal-authority separation remains a required RAKL invariant but is explicitly excluded from standalone novelty. T001 is narrowed to the integrated method conjunction.

updates.new_evidence: GAVEL and EG-VAR show strong prior art for atomic evidence binding and mechanized/formal verification.
updates.target_refinement: RAKL must benchmark scientific support scope, contradiction/omission coverage, observation and lineage authority, and which scientific authority coordinate an evidence packet can legally mint.

updates.note: Ablate the proposed authority poset and measure whether evidence strong on one dimension is incorrectly promoted to mechanism/identification/decision authority on another.
The authority predicate in the Round-009 state theory should be specialized by the N035 poset rather than treated as a total authority ladder.
